connector.name: Medical Terminologies MCP
connector.registryDescription: Diagnoses, drugs & lab codes: ICD-11, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC, CID-10. 37 tools, MIT.
connector.summary: Hosted at medical.sidneybissoli.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package medical-terminologies-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sidneybissoli account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: WHO_CLIENT_ID
env.description: WHO ICD-11 API Client ID. Required only for ICD-11 tools (5 tools); the server starts without it and other terminologies (LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC, CID-10) work unauthenticated. Get credentials at https://icd.who.int/icdapi.

env.name: WHO_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: WHO ICD-11 API Client Secret. Required only for ICD-11 tools.

env.name: WHO_ICD11_RELEASE_ID
env.description: ICD-11 release to query (e.g. 2024-01, 2025-01). Optional; defaults to 2024-01.

env.name: ENABLE_SNOMED_TOOLS
env.description: Set to 'true' to register the 6 SNOMED-dependent tools (snomed_search, snomed_concept, snomed_hierarchy, snomed_descriptions, snomed_ecl, plus map_snomed_to_icd10). Disabled by default because the historical public IHTSDO Snowstorm endpoint was retired (HTTP 410 Gone). Requires SNOMED_BASE_URL pointing at a working self-hosted Snowstorm.

env.name: SNOMED_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Snowstorm instance (e.g. https://my-snowstorm.example.com/snowstorm/snomed-ct). Required only when ENABLE_SNOMED_TOOLS is true.

env.name: SNOMED_LANGUAGE
env.description: Accept-Language tag(s) for SNOMED responses (e.g. pt, pt-BR, es). Optional; defaults to 'en'. Composite values with q-weights depend on the upstream Snowstorm instance.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: pino log level (debug, info, warn, error, fatal). Optional; defaults to 'info'. Logs go to stderr only — never stdout (which is the MCP stdio transport).
